prompt: Which prime minister has been in office between 2017 and 2022 and also shares their middle name with a former monarch of Scotland.
answer: Theresa May — her middle name is **Mary**, shared with **Mary, Queen of Scots**. She served as UK prime minister from 2016 to 2019, within the 2017–2022 period.
